print(f"  January 1945: {yields[2]}%")

for i, ad in enumerate(absolute_deviations):
    print(f"  {yields[i]}%: |{yields[i]} - {benchmark}| = {ad}")

# Calculate average deviation
average_deviation = sum(absolute_deviations) / len(absolute_deviations)
print(f"\nAverage deviation = ({'+'.join([str(ad) for ad in absolute_deviations])}) / 3")
print(f"                  = {sum(absolute_deviations)} / 3")
print(f"                  = {average_deviation}")
print(f"\nFinal result (rounded to 2 decimal places): {round(average_deviation, 2)} percentage points")
EOF
